caption: A lantern is carried through a dark campsite, and the pool of light moves along the ground with it.

sa.check: A lantern is carried through a campsite.
The pool of light moves along the ground with it.

pc.expect: The lit area travels with the lantern and the tents brighten as it passes and darken behind.
pc.fail: The lit area stays put while the lantern moves; or tents stay lit after it has passed; or light appears ahead of it.

pc.expect: The light moves only with the lantern.
pc.fail: It drifts with the lantern still; or moves the opposite way; or jumps.

pc.expect: The pool is one soft patch around the lantern.
pc.fail: It is a sharp beam; or splits; or floods the whole site.

pc.expect: Shadows point away from the lantern.
pc.fail: They point toward it; or in several directions; or there are none.

pc.expect: One lantern and one pool of light.
pc.fail: A second pool appears with one lantern; or the lantern vanishes; or the light becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The tents and the ground stay the same.
pc.fail: A tent changes colour rather than brightness; or moves; or the ground changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged. Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
